- [EX agentic skills -- detailed inventory for RHOAI catalog planning](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-ex-agentic-skills-detailed-inventory.md) — Full breakdown of Red Hat Emerging Technology (EX) agentic skill packs -- 7 packs, ~68 skills total, organized by persona; key input for building the initial RHOAI skills catalog list (RHAISTRAT-1940).

- [KEP-0005 merged in kubeflow/hub -- skills catalog is the 4th catalog type](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-kep-0005-skills-catalog-upstream.md) — KEP-0005 (Skills Catalog) merged Jul 27-31 2026 in kubeflow/hub -- SKILL.md parser (SKC-104), OpenAPI spec + codegen (SKC-101), plugin scaffold (SKC-103) all landed; rareddy (Red Hat) authored; 32-task tracking issue
- [NVIDIA skills ecosystem -- mature catalog, verification pipeline, complementary to MLflow](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-nvidia-skills-catalog-landscape.md) — NVIDIA has the most mature public skills catalog (2.7K stars, 35+ products, OMS signing, SkillSpector scanning, Skill Evaluator, Tier-3 evals, BENCHMARK.md, agentskills.io compliance, 5+ marketplace syndications); complements MLflow (trust/quality layer, not a registry). JFrog already partnered at GTC 2026.

Converting these to catalog entries is the minimum viable content path for RHAISTRAT-1940.
- [Skills Catalog 3.6 scope -- browse-only TP with pre-loaded content](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-catalog-36-scope-recommendation.md) — Research-backed 3.6 scope recommendation -- read-only browse/search with 15-20 pre-loaded curated skills; installation automation and registry integration deferred to 3.7+; matches MCP Catalog DP-to-TP and Agent Catalog DP link-out precedents.
- [Skills Catalog direction -- Kubeflow, Git-backed, disconnected image](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-catalog-direction.md) — Catalog direction established 2026-07-23 -- Kubeflow hub surface, GitHub repos as skill source, downstream image build for disconnected, metadata labels for grouping (no bundling), admin-manages/user-browses.
- [Skills Catalog -- overview and current status](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-catalog-overview.md) — Skills Catalog is the AI Hub storefront for AI agent skills (Kubeflow surface, alongside MCP/agent catalogs); direction established 2026-07-23, pre-partition.
- [RHAISTRAT-1780 -- Skills Catalog scope and architecture](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-catalog-rhaistrat-1780-scope.md) — RHAISTRAT-1780 Skills Catalog scope -- Go backend with PostgreSQL, odh-dashboard React/PatternFly 6 BFF UI module, trust tiers (RH/Partner/Org/Community), ConfigMap disconnected import, usage telemetry, 6-9 sprint effort estimate.
- [Skills registry/catalog competitive landscape (2026-07-21)](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-competitive-landscape-2026.md) — Comprehensive competitive landscape -- cloud platforms (AWS AgentCore, Azure Agent 365, Google Gemini Enterprise, Databricks Unity AI), frameworks (Anthropic Marketplace ~600 skills, skills.sh 669K+, HF 40K+ with ARD spec, LangChain/LangSmith), security specialists (JFrog+NVIDIA, Cisco DefenseClaw, Credo AI, Zenity, TrueFoundry); SKILL.md is the standard (16+ tools), EU AI Act high-risk Aug 2 2026.
- [Skills ecosystem terminology -- precision definitions for RH context](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-ecosystem-terminology.md) — Agreed definitions for skills ecosystem terms as used across RH teams -- Agent Skill, Plugin, Marketplace, Skill Bundle, Skill Card, Skill Signature, Installed Skill, Code/Artifact Repository, Package Manager; avoids ambiguity in cross-team discussions.
- [Pre-loaded skills (RHAISTRAT-1940) -- catalog empty-launch risk](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-preloaded-content-risk.md) — RHAISTRAT-1940 (pre-loaded skills) -- PM assigned 2026-08-02 (existential risk mitigated); Peter working with EX and PE teams to build the skills list; deadline before 3.6 EA1 completes so EA2+Stable have time for integration.
- [Skills supply chain threat landscape and mitigation plan](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skills-supply-chain-security.md) — Detailed threat landscape for AI agent skills (ClawHavoc 1100+ poisoned, Snyk 13% critical, NL malware, memory alteration, privilege inheritance) plus Red Hat's mitigation plan (static/behavioral scanning, signed/attested skills via Konflux, trusted repos, OpenShell deny-by-default, partner verification program).
- [SkillsBench -- curated skills raise pass rates by 16.2pp; quality beats volume](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-skillsbench-quality-evidence.md) — SkillsBench (Stanford/CMU/Berkeley/Oxford, arXiv 2602.12670) scored 47,150 public skills -- average quality 6.2/12, 73% elevated safety risk; curated skills +16.2pp pass rate, self-generated -1.3pp; focused 2-3 module skills +18.6pp vs larger bundles +5.9pp.
- [Three independent Red Hat skill sources exist with no consolidation](/components/skills-catalog/knowledge/fact-three-rh-skill-sources.md) — Three RH orgs produce skills independently -- EX agentic-plugins (7 packs, ~68 skills), openshift/agentic-skills (Lightspeed-tied, 3 skills), opendatahub-io/ai-helpers (ODH Claude Code marketplace); Kubeflow hub can federate all three via separate source configs but no one owns the consolidation.
